column1: # Independent pin for the shell-test tier inventory in tools/shell-test-tier.test.ts.
# One tracked shell test per line, sorted. The executor asserts that this file and
# its own inventory name exactly the same set, so removing a shell test from the
# tier stays a deliberate two-place edit and cannot happen by dropping one line.
# This replaced an aggregate count (`toHaveLength(N)`) held in the executor. A
# count is merge-blind: two lanes that each add one shell test both write the
# same N+1 on the same line, git's three-way merge keeps that identical change
# once, and the merged tree carries N+2 entries while asserting N+1 — green on
# each branch alone, red only after the merge, at the meteorite. One line per
